title: API resource
description: Generates a NestJS resource that follows apps/api/AGENTS.md exactly.

name.description: Singular resource name, e.g. payment or payment-reminder.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields as name:type or name?:type (optional). Types: string, int, decimal, boolean, date.

plural.description: Plural name, only when appending s/es/ies is wrong.
